scenario: [IRET.6.3]: every regex pattern is compiled when the artefact loads, including one under an `is` test. Two rules, two patterns: `plain` matches `u.name ~ /^ali/` directly, `boxed` matches `(u.name ~ /x+$/) is true`. With the second pattern missing from libds's load-time cache, the first pattern makes the cache exist, the `is` operand's match misses it, and libds answers FAULT(DS_FAULT_ARTEFACT) -- an EngineError that halts the tier -- while the Mercury runtime, which compiles at match, fires. PATH PINNED: the DS_RETE_EXPR_IS_TEST arm of `regex_walk_expr` in runtime/src/libds/builtins.c, which `ds_rete_regex_precompile` walks every beta guard and terminal action with. `name` is `String?` so that `plain`'s match stays a beta join test, in the cache this pins: a decided match on a non-nullable slot is an alpha REGEX test (RLOW.5.2.2), which carries its own compiled pattern and is not in that cache. Pin: `alix` fires both rules, in source order; `bob` fires neither.
rules_ds:
schema User scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    name: String? mutable

rule plain:
    User u where u.name ~ /^ali/
->
    log info "plain"

rule boxed:
    User u where (u.name ~ /x+$/) is true
->
    log info "boxed"
